_comment: E-RX-2 frozen item bank (10 items). Drafted at freeze, 2026-09-05 ~22:45 CT, on Travis's go; no subject has seen any of these texts. 'naive' is arm A exactly as a plausible user writes it. Declared edits are the only material the transformations may touch: 'urgency' and 'register' are exact substrings deleted by T-URG / T-REG (each must occur exactly once in 'naive'); 'constraints' are the lines T-FENCE restates as a leading block; 'fence_min' is the single sentence T-FENCE-min appends; 'license' is the sentence T-LIC prepends (null where the item instructs no deviation from truth/correctness); 'stakes' is the sentence T-STAKES appends (null where the item carries no stakes cue). 'differential' marks items whose hazard is NOT repaired by fencing alone.
